lq.q: Find the half-range sine series for \(f(x)=\cos x\) in \((0,\pi)\).
answer: Step Marks Sine series: \(\cos x=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}b_n\sin nx\) (1) \(b_n=\frac{2}{\pi}\int_0^{\pi}\cos x\sin nx\,dx=\frac{2n}{\pi}\cdot\frac{1+(-1)^n}{1-n^2}\) for \(n\neq1\) (4) \(b_1=0\) (2) Thus, \(\cos x=\frac{8}{\pi}\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{n}{4n^2-1}\sin 2nx\) (4) Verification at \(x=\frac{\pi}{2}\) (4)
